notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a combat surf loop (its readme: 'all about ramp combat ... grab yourself an M3'). 20 spawns a side facing each other, 64 placed shotguns, scouts, TMPs and G3s, four teleports into jail1..jail4 and no line a run could end at. chk-maps run 64. Not published.
kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
